meta_data.base_class: Review and suggest improvements for the privacy settings of <electronic devices> - refers to any physical electronic hardware with configurable privacy options.

tool_template.name: <class>PrivacySettingsReview
tool_template.description: Review and suggest improvements for the privacy settings of a <class>.

device_serial.description: The serial number of the <class>. It must be a string of 10 to 20 alphanumeric characters.

current_privacy_level.description: The current privacy level setting of the <class>, e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

user_consent_status.description: Indicates whether the user has provided consent for the <class> to collect personal data.

location_services_enabled.description: Specifies if location services are enabled on the <class>.

third_party_integrations.description: Number of external third-party integrations connected to the <class>.

data_sharing_scope.description: Current scope of user data sharing by the <class>: 'internal', 'third-party', or 'public'.
